title: Planning next release 1.11.4 or 1.12.0
body: Let’s identify open PRs that should be in the next release and discuss other release issues here.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: In the case we have not merged any code after the last release that warrants a minor feature bump: Since we are still releasing from a single branch, perhaps we should first release backward compatible fixes as 1.11.4 then immediately follow up with a 1.12.0 release that includes backward incompatible changes and/or other fixes that warrant a minor version bump.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Can I ask about the planned timeline for this release? It actually has the fix I'm looking for (#6416). Or is there anything I can do to speed it up?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: All plans are here in the open.  No plans of an actual date yet.

comments.author: participant1
